newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian pound firmer despite dollar shortage.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian pound firmer despite dollar shortage.

text.p: The Egyptian pound was a fraction firmer against the dollar in the private-sector money market on Monday despite a continuing shortage of dollars, bankers said.
"The U.S. dollar is still in demand," one banker said.
Private-sector bankers said the dollar ranged from 3.3950 pounds to 3.3980 pounds bid and from 3.3965 pounds to 3.3990 offered in the interbank market.
A survey of four actively trading banks gave average rates of 3.3961 pounds bid and 3.3977 pounds offered. These averages compared to 3.3964 pounds bid and 3.3978 offered on Sunday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at closing as 3.390289 buy and 3.392322 sell.
